condition_selection_rationale: Selected on the 25-task development smoke set (seed-1101 corpus, never qualification data). direct: B3-B0=1.00, B2-B0=0.64, B1/B1b-B0=0.00, 1.1s mean latency, 7.4 mean completion tokens with terse well-formed answers. cot: B3-B0=0.80 at 9.6s/44.1 tokens with rambling self-questioning output. synth,cot: B3-B0=0.80 at 9.1s/52.7 tokens. direct dominates every axis; comparison receipts in evidence/hrm_smoke_v2_{direct,cot,synthcot}.

decoding.notes: greedy; generation limit identical across arms
